versions.subject: Merge PR #5518 from @ruppde - new rule and updates for ADExplorer
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\ADExp.exe'
          - '\ADExplorer.exe'
          - '\ADExplorer64.exe'
          - '\ADExplorer64a.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'AdExp'
    - Description: 'Active Directory Editor'
    - Product: 'Sysinternals ADExplorer'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains: 'snapshot'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\ADExp.exe", "*\\ADExplorer.exe", "*\\ADExplorer64.exe", "*\\ADExplorer64a.exe") OR OriginalFileName="AdExp" OR Description="Active Directory Editor" OR Product="Sysinternals ADExplorer" CommandLine="*snapshot*"
